notes.f1: Lydia Grice present as I1, daughter of Edwin (R15) and Hannah (R16), with christening F1 = 8 Aug 1878 West Bromwich citing S1 (QL3R-C5SR — the Staffordshire Church Records entry). Parent-child relationships correctly cite S1 (christening), fixing the citation-hygiene issue flagged in prior runs. f1 = true stands on identity, parentage, and the christening. Three caveats. (1) Birth year: the tree records F5 Birth ~1879, primary:true, sourced only to S2 (1881 census) and S3 (1891 census) — the christening year 1878 never reaches a birth fact. The fixture README calls ~1879 the census artifact that is 'a year off' and states the correct path is to record only the year 1878 sourced to the christening entry. (2) Unexamined candidate: Fanny Grice (ark:/61903/1:1:QL3R-6ZDW, bapt. 6 Mar 1889 West Bromwich, collection 2364451) appears zero times in this run's research.json and tree, yet the run's exhaustive_search_summary claims to have searched that exact collection across all West Bromwich parishes and the proof summary makes the strong negative claim that Lydia was the only additional child. Whether Fanny is a real child is unresolved — the 2026-09-09 run's c_001 flagged her mother reading as 'Anne' not 'Hannah' — but an unexamined candidate in the claimed-exhausted collection that contradicts the headline negative claim is a proof-quality debit. (3) Register image not opened: parentage still rests on one indexed record in one informant chain with no image verification. PQ 2: the citation hygiene is fixed, but these three caveats together prevent a higher score.
